[RFCS.23.6] **The receiving engine decides a fact's lifetime.** A `FactExternal`
carries none. The receiving engine applies its own schema's lifecycle, so a tier's lifetimes are
decided by its own program and reproduce on replay. A per-emit TTL override
([LDTL.4.1]) is local to the engine that emitted the fact; an author who needs a
lifetime to cross a boundary puts it in a slot.
